'''''Foundations of Science''''' is a [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[interdisciplinarity|interdisciplinary]] [[academic journal]] focussing on [[Methodology|methodological]] and [[Philosophy|philosophical]] topics concerning the structure and growth of [[science]]. It is the official journal of the [[Association for Foundations of Science, Language and Cognition]] and is published quarterly by [[Springer Science+Business Media]]. The journal was established in 1995. The [[editor in chief]] is [[Diederik Aerts]].

== Abstracting and indexing ==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in [[Arts and Humanities Citation Index]], [[Cengage Learning|Cengage]],  [[EBSCO Industries|EBSCO Databases]], [[FRANCIS]], [[Google Scholar]], [[Mathematical Reviews]], [[PASCAL (database)|PASCAL]], [[Science Citation Index|Science Citation Index Expanded]], [[Scopus]], and [[Zentralblatt MATH]].
